breakdown.description: The setup describes a vertical bubble column with gas injected to rise along the Y-axis, but gravity is applied horizontally, which would push the bubbles sideways instead of upwards.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains the incorrect gravity vector `g (-9.81 0 0)` from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires `g (0 -9.81 0)` so that gravity acts downward along the Y-axis (the vertical direction of the column). The agent failed to identify and fix this inconsistency.
